# AGA Welding & Fabrication — Complete Business Profile

## Business Overview
**Name**: AGA Welding & Fabrication  
**Type**: Metal Fabrication and Welding Contractor  
**Primary Location**: 8249 Gardner Rd, San Antonio, TX 78263  
**Years in Business**: 43 years (Established 1983)  
**Tagline**: Where Precision Meets Steel  
**Business Structure**: Licensed Texas contractor specializing in comprehensive metal fabrication, certified welding, and structural steel work  
**Service Coverage**: Greater San Antonio metropolitan area and Bexar County

## Complete Service Catalog

### Steel and Metal Fabrication Services

**Steel Fabrication**  
Comprehensive steel fabrication services for commercial and industrial applications. Precision cutting, forming, and assembly of steel components. Services include:
- Custom steel component fabrication from raw materials
- Precision plasma cutting and saw cutting
- Steel forming and bending
- Welded steel assemblies
- Structural support fabrication
- Industrial steel components
- Commercial building steel elements

**Structural Steel Fabrication**  
Engineered structural steel fabrication for construction and heavy-duty applications. Built to specification and industry building codes:
- I-beams and H-beams fabrication
- Steel columns and posts
- Structural framing systems
- Load-bearing steel assemblies
- Construction steel packages
- Bridge and infrastructure components
- Seismic-rated structural elements
- Code-compliant engineered designs

**Sheet Metal Fabrication**  
Precision sheet metal services including cutting, bending, and assembly:
- HVAC ductwork and components
- Industrial enclosures and panels
- Custom metal boxes and housings
- Decorative architectural sheet metal
- Automotive and equipment panels
- Precision-bent sheet metal parts
- Galvanized and stainless sheet metal work

**Metal Cutting Services**  
Professional metal cutting using modern equipment and techniques:
- Plasma cutting for thick steel plate
- Band saw cutting for structural steel
- Abrasive cutting for hard metals
- Precision tolerance cutting
- Profile and shape cutting
- Cut-to-length services
- Any gauge or material thickness

**Metal Bending and Forming**  
Expert metal bending and forming services for custom shapes and components:
- Press brake bending
- Roll forming for curved sections
- Tube and pipe bending
- Angle iron bending
- Structural shapes formed to specification
- Decorative scrollwork and ornamental bending
- Repeatable production bending

**Metal Assembly**  
Professional metal assembly and component integration:
- Multi-part steel structures
- Bolted and riveted assemblies
- Welded structural assemblies
- Sub-assembly fabrication
- Component fitting and alignment
- Final assembly and finishing

**Custom Metalwork**  
Artistic and functional custom metalwork for decorative and practical applications:
- Decorative metal gates
- Custom metal signage
- Architectural metalwork
- Artistic metal sculptures
- Functional metal art
- Bespoke metal furniture
- One-of-a-kind custom projects

### Certified Welding Services

**MIG Welding (Metal Inert Gas)**  
Professional MIG welding for efficient and precise metal joining:
- General fabrication welding
- Production welding work
- Sheet metal welding
- Automotive and equipment repair welding
- Aluminum MIG welding
- Stainless steel MIG welding
- Carbon steel joining

**TIG Welding (Tungsten Inert Gas)**  
Precision TIG welding for high-quality joints and detailed metalwork:
- Stainless steel TIG welding
- Aluminum TIG welding
- Thin material welding
- Precision ornamental welding
- Aerospace-quality welds
- Food-grade stainless applications
- Critical joint welding

**Stick Welding (SMAW - Shielded Metal Arc Welding)**  
Reliable stick welding for structural and outdoor applications:
- Structural steel welding
- Heavy equipment repair
- Outdoor and field welding
- Thick material joining
- Cast iron welding and repair
- Farm and ranch equipment welding

**Flux-Cored Welding (FCAW)**  
High-speed flux-cored welding for thick materials and structural work:
- Structural steel joining
- High-deposition welding
- Heavy industrial fabrication
- Thick plate welding
- Production welding applications

**Pipe Welding**  
Expert pipe welding services for industrial and commercial applications:
- Pressure vessel welding
- Pipeline welding
- Process piping systems
- Plumbing and HVAC piping
- Industrial pipe fabrication
- Certified pipe welding procedures

**Structural Welding**  
Professional structural steel welding for buildings, bridges, and infrastructure:
- Building frame welding
- Bridge component welding
- Infrastructure welding
- AWS D1.1 compliant welding
- Certified welding procedures
- Non-destructive testing coordination

**Mobile Welding**  
On-site welding services brought directly to your San Antonio location:
- Emergency repair welding
- Field fabrication
- On-site structural welding
- Equipment repair at your facility
- Construction site welding services
- Agricultural equipment welding
- Anywhere in the greater San Antonio area

## Process and Workflow

### Design and Consultation
AGA Welding & Fabrication works with clients from initial concept through final installation. Services include:
- Free project consultation and estimates
- Review of existing drawings and specifications
- Design consultation for custom projects
- Material selection guidance
- Budget planning and cost estimation
- Timeline development

### Fabrication Process
1. Blueprint review or design development
2. Material procurement and preparation
3. Precision cutting and forming
4. Certified welding and assembly
5. Quality inspection
6. Finishing (grinding, painting, coating as specified)
7. Delivery or installation coordination

### Quality Control
Every project undergoes rigorous quality control:
- Visual inspection of all welds
- Dimensional verification
- Fit and finish inspection
- Certification documentation
- Customer walkthrough and approval

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What metal fabrication services does AGA Welding & Fabrication offer?**  
We provide structural steel work, custom welding, metal staircases and railings, awnings, storage racks, industrial components, and specialized fabrication. We work with various metals and handle projects of any scale across San Antonio.

**How fast can you turn around a fabrication project?**  
Timeline depends on scope and complexity. We prioritize efficiency without cutting corners and set realistic schedules during consultation. Rush services are available for urgent repairs and deadlines. Typical small projects: 1-3 days. Medium projects: 1-2 weeks. Large structural packages: coordination with project timeline.

**Do you work from existing drawings or can you help with design?**  
We do both. Our San Antonio team can consult on your concept and bring ideas to life from scratch, or fabricate directly from your existing blueprints and specifications. We have experience interpreting engineering drawings and working with architects, engineers, and contractors.

**Are your welders certified and what quality guarantees do you provide?**  
All welders are certified professionals. We maintain rigorous quality control standards on every joint and stand behind our work with a commitment to durability and precision. Welding procedures meet AWS standards and can be documented for project specifications.

**Do you serve residential clients or only commercial and industrial?**  
We serve commercial, industrial, and residential customers throughout San Antonio. Whether it's a residential gate and railing or a large industrial structural package, we have the expertise to deliver quality results.

**What areas around San Antonio does AGA Welding & Fabrication cover?**  
Based at 8249 Gardner Rd in southeast San Antonio (78263), we serve the greater San Antonio and Bexar County area including Boerne, New Braunfels, Seguin, and surrounding communities. Mobile welding service brings our crew directly to your job site when projects cannot come to our shop.

**What is the cost for metal fabrication work?**  
Costs vary based on materials, complexity, size, and timeline. We provide free estimates after reviewing project requirements. Factors affecting cost include metal type and thickness, welding complexity, finishing requirements, and delivery/installation needs.

**Do you offer emergency or rush services?**  
Yes, rush services are available for urgent repairs and time-sensitive projects. Contact us to discuss your timeline and we'll work to accommodate emergency needs.

## About AGA Welding & Fabrication

Established in 1983, AGA Welding & Fabrication has served the San Antonio area for over four decades with expert metal fabrication and certified welding services. Our team brings deep technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and commitment to quality on every project.

Whether you need structural steel for a commercial building, custom railings for your home, or emergency equipment repair, AGA Welding & Fabrication delivers precision craftsmanship built to last. Our family-run business prioritizes customer relationships and takes pride in work that exceeds expectations.

From small residential projects to large industrial fabrication, we approach every job with the same attention to detail and commitment to quality. Our certified welders, modern equipment, and decades of experience ensure your project is done right the first time.
